how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for STCL Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 11-10-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the STCL Operations Positions?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the STCL Operations Positions is 11-10-2026. Ensure your application reaches them before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Operations Positions at STCL?
faq.answer: Sahakar Taxi Cooperative (STCL) has announced a total of 15 vacancies for various Operations Positions in their latest recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Associate (Operations) post?
faq.answer: For the Associate (Operations) post, candidates must be a Graduate from an institution of repute and possess a minimum of 3 years of experience, preferably in a ride-hailing organization.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for STCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the STCL Operations Positions recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the Operations Positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the Operations Positions at Sahakar Taxi Cooperative is 40 years as of 31-07-2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary range for the Operations Positions?
faq.answer: The salary for the Operations Positions ranges from Rs 5 LPA to Rs 13.75 LPA per annum, depending on the specific post and experience.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for the STCL Operations Positions involves two main stages: CV Screening followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates with experience in ride-hailing organizations get preference?
faq.answer: Yes, the notification explicitly states that experience in a ride-hailing organization is preferred for most of the Operations Positions.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions advertised by Sahakar Taxi Cooperative for Operations are on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for STCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section provided in this article. It contains all the detailed information about the recruitment.
